The grievance of the petitioners is that without initiating any land acquisition proceeding as well as without issuing any specific notice, their land has been acquired purportedly under Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
It is the further case that the petitioners were not given any chance to raise any objection while fixing compensation.

The respondent BSF has filed an affidavit inter alia taking a stand that on their request 15 bigha 03 katta 08 lessa of patta land and 01 bigha 01 kath 03 lessa of Government Khas land has been acquired and the BSF had already deposited a sum of Rs. 10,97,276/- (Rupees Ten Lakh Ninety Seven Thousand Two Hundred Seventy Six) only with the Deputy Commissioner, Karimganj.

According to the respondent BSF authority, 15 bigha 03 katta 08 lessa of land was handed over to the BSF on 29.01.2014 and 01 bigha 01 katta 03 lessa of land was handed over on 28.07.2014 and the said land has already been mutated in the name of BSF as on 03.01.2018.

In view of the aforesaid, the Collector cum Deputy Commissioner, Karimganj shall file an affidavit showing the procedure adhered by the Deputy Commissioner in acquiring the land and also to clarify whether the land of the petitioners are involved in the land acquisition process.
Page No.# 5/5 In the affidavit, the Deputy Commissioner, shall also incorporate the date of passing the award if any under the Land Acquisition Act.
List this mater on 28.10.2024.
